headline: Gas stations in Kyiv under attack: drivers told whether there will be a fuel shortage and price spike
summary: Russian attacks on gas stations in Ukraine raise questions about fuel shortages, logistics problems and rising prices. An energy expert was asked whether the attacks threaten supply.
why: Fuel retail networks depend on refining, logistics and imports, so attacks on stations can disrupt supply and push up pump prices. Energy disruptions in Ukraine also affect the wider economy.
